newsitem.title: UK: MAM shares benefit from stock market rally.
newsitem.headline: MAM shares benefit from stock market rally.

text.p: Shares in Mercury Asset Management Plc, one of the UK's biggest fund management groups, rose on Monday as international stock markets climbed to record levels.

Shares in MAM were up 25-1/2p at 10.84 stg by 0950 GMT, but volume was a relatively slim 126,000. "Wall Street has reached a new high and the UK stock market is at record levels so fund management companies are going to do better," said one industry analyst.
"MAM is a quality company in an industry with great growth prospects," the analyst said. "If people want to put money in the sector then MAM is one of the most liquid stocks." he added.

But market-makers said they were suffering from a shortage of stock amid renewed demand for the shares today. MAM shares last week, and were still recommending the stock at today's price level, market sources said.
"The shares are attractive long term...and not just because stock markets are at record levels," said the analyst.
Elsewhere in the sector shares in Schroders Plc also gained strength today. By 1010 GMT the shares were up 17-1/2p at 14.55 stg, again in thin volume of just 21,000 shares.
